snippet.title: VAMP Performance Evidence Desk: Stop hunting performance evidence at review time.
snippet.description:
VAMP Performance Evidence Desk is part of the KnowEdge AutoRelease Suite.

Buyer: Academic staff, HR administrators, department heads, and performance review coordinators
Pain: Performance agreements and evidence live in separate files, email threads, and forgotten folders.
Promise: Task/KPA mapping, evidence candidates, gaps, and a review-ready performance snapshot.

CTA: Send a task agreement and one month of evidence for a pilot snapshot.

This is a review-first workflow. Human approval remains required.
